toilet-shower-3x1.name: Restroom & Shower Unit 3×1
toilet-shower-3x1.shortDescription: An XPV insulated-panel restroom and shower unit – a toilet, a vanity with mirror, and a shower tray with a handheld shower and faucet.

details.title: The unit
details.text: A 3×1 m restroom and shower unit of XPV insulated panels, for durability and thermal and acoustic insulation, on an aluminum frame. A rigid, stable inner floor, a door with a cylinder lock and skylight windows up top for daylight.

details.title: Inside
details.text: A toilet, a vanity with sink, faucet and built-in mirror, and a shower tray with a handheld shower and faucet for everyday use.

details.title: Installation
details.text: The unit stands on a stable, firm, level surface. Delivery and installation (₪2,000) include coming to you, professional installation and a walkthrough of how to use it. Licensed professionals connect the water, sewage and power.

guard-booth-2x2.name: Guard Booth 2×2
guard-booth-2x2.shortDescription: A guard booth built from insulated panels and heavy-duty aluminum profiles, with 3 sliding windows and an electrical panel (lighting and 3 outlets). Price includes delivery and installation.
